description: This source file implements a variety of functions for Wi-Fi Access Point configuration, initialization, deinitialization, and management within a broader Wi-Fi management framework. It includes code for handling hostapd configurations, radius server setup, interface and BSS (Basic Service Set) management, and support for features like RADIUS greylisting, WPA/WPA2/WPA3 security, and Wi-Fi standards configuration.

methods.name: void update_default_oem_configs(int apIndex,struct hostapd_bss_config * bss)
methods.description: Reads JSON configuration from a file and updates device-specific parameters like device name, manufacturer, model, serial number, and other OEM info in the BSS config structure.

methods.name: void update_radius_config(struct hostapd_bss_config * conf)
methods.description: Initializes radius server configurations within the BSS config if IEEE 802.1X is enabled.

methods.name: int hostapd_tr181_config_parse_key_mgmt(int modeEnabled)
methods.description: Generates WPA key management configuration based on TR-181 (COSA) security mode settings.

methods.name: int hostapd_tr181_config_parse_cipher(int encryptionMethod)
methods.description: Converts TR-181 encryption setting into corresponding WPA cipher configuration.

methods.name: void hostapd_config_free_wps(struct hostapd_bss_config * conf)
methods.description: Frees WPS-related dynamically allocated strings in the hostapd BSS configuration.

methods.name: void hostapd_config_free_bss(struct hostapd_bss_config * conf)
methods.description: Frees and cleans up a hostapd_bss_config structure, including WPS, radius, and other nested configurations.

methods.name: void update_hostapd_iface(int ap_index,struct hostapd_iface * iface,struct hostapd_data * hapd)
methods.description: Initializes a hostapd_iface structure with core configuration data, setting driver flags.

methods.name: void update_hostapd_iconf(int ap_index,struct hostapd_config * conf)
methods.description: Initializes hostapd global configuration defaults, including beacon interval, WMM parameters, country code, and other settings.

methods.name: void update_hostapd_bss_config(int ap_index,struct hostapd_bss_config * bss)
methods.description: Initializes default BSS (Basic Service Set) configuration parameters such as security, timeouts, cipher suites, and other Wi-Fi specific settings.

methods.name: void update_config_defaults(int ap_index,struct hostapd_data * hapd,int ModeEnabled)
methods.description: Sets default parameters for hostapd configuration, including security mode, radius servers, interface, and various Wi-Fi features.

methods.name: void hapd_init_log_files()
methods.description: Initializes log files for hostapd debug and other logging mechanisms.

methods.name: void convert_apindex_to_interface(int idx,char * iface,int len)
methods.description: Maps a given AP index to its corresponding interface name string based on a predefined mapping.

methods.name: int libhostapd_global_init()
methods.description: Initializes global hostapd parameters, sets up eloop mechanism, registers EAP methods, and prepares driver interface list.

methods.name: struct:hostapd_config * libhostapd_config_read(const char * fname,int apIndex)
methods.description: Reads default hostapd configuration for a given AP index, sets driver, and ISR properties.

methods.name: struct:hostapd_iface * libhostapd_init(struct hapd_interfaces * interfaces,const char * config_file,int apIndex)
methods.description: Creates and initializes hostapd interface and BSS configurations based on templates, for a given AP index.

methods.name: struct:hostapd_iface * libhostapd_interface_init(struct hapd_interfaces * interfaces,const char * if_name,const char * config_fname,int debug,int apIndex)
methods.description: Complete interface initialization, including configuration reading and setup, for a specific interface name and debug level.

methods.name: void libhostapd_global_deinit()
methods.description: De-initializes global hostapd state, releases driver, eloop, log files, and cleans up global structures.

methods.name: void deinit_eloop()
methods.description: Cleans up and destroys the eloop thread infrastructure used by hostapd.

methods.name: int hapd_reload_ssid(int apIndex,char * ssid)
methods.description: Updates the SSID on a running hostapd instance, reinitializing the WPA PSK and setting the kernel interface SSID.

methods.name: int hapd_reload_authentication(int apIndex,char * keyPassphrase)
methods.description: Reloads the WPA passphrase and security settings on a running hostapd instance.

methods.name: int hapd_reload_encryption_method(int apIndex,int encryptionMethod)
methods.description: Reconfigures the encryption method (TKIP, CCMP, etc.) on a running hostapd instance, including reinitialization of WPA settings.

methods.name: void hapd_reset_ap_interface(int apIndex)
methods.description: Resets the AP interface for a given index by tearing down and recreating the interface.
